obligation: S08 requires edit, acknowledged recalculation, and return of the calculated workbook.
observed_boundary: The selected-document custody check accepts both files. It does not decide whether this turn requires recalculation. The installed write guidance checks the count before a claim but does not condition file selection on that count.
remaining: For an explicit computed-result request, verify the expected nonzero recalculation count on the returned path and match the received SHA. Edit-only requests must still be supported. Separately admissible ordinary execution and formal grading remain open.
